ROOT CAUSE OF THE DIAMOND LATTICE — it is NOT the source art, it is the compositing in art.py _gen_tiles, and I have numbers. Measured the 16 grass diamonds in assets/flare/raw/tiles/grassland.png: mean luminance per variant 80.4..83.3, spread only 2.9 levels — the sheet is effectively uniform, so no amount of new painted tiles will remove the pattern by itself. What _gen_tiles does instead (art.py ~259-301): (1) it takes ONLY the centre crop rect (16,10,32,12) of each 64x32 diamond and smooths it up to full size, so every tile is a different magnified patch; (2) it masks that texture with a hard diamond polygon (alpha 255 inside, 0 outside); (3) it sets tex alpha to 58; (4) tiles are then drawn over the flat TARGET fill. Net effect: on every single tile the interior sits at a different brightness than the base fill, and the mask gives each tile a hard diamond edge — 3,000 visible diamond outlines = the lattice.
